info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Account Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Account Reconciliation Retrieval API provides the capability to obtain detailed account reconciliation information based on a specific parameter. This endpoint allows users to access critical financial data pertinent to account management. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications and financial services platforms that require insights into account discrepancies. By leveraging this API, developers can facilitate more accurate and efficient account management processes.

get.description: Fetches the detailed information of the account reconciliation for a specified ID, allowing users to understand its state and related data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve account reconciliation information for a specific account. It should provide necessary parameters to identify the account and its reconciliation status.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning account reconciliation data.

GetAccountManagementByParam1Request.description: A string representation of the request body for the account reconciliation operation.

GetAccountManagementByParam1Response_200.title: Account Reconciliation Response

accountId.description: The unique identifier for the account.

customerId.description: The unique identifier for the customer associated with the account.

ledgerDate.description: The date of the ledger entry in ISO 8601 format.

currency.description: The currency code for the account balance (e.g., USD, EUR).

ledgerBalance.description: The current balance of the ledger for the account.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record which indicates its current state.

version.description: The version of the account reconciliation record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of when the account record was last updated in ISO 8601 format.

GetAccountManagementByParam1Response_200.description: This schema represents the response for the account reconciliation operation, which includes details about the account and its current state.
